entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date after the day you plan to leave St Lucia.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento posterior al día en que planeas salir de Santa Lucía.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ after the day you plan to leave

entry.en: You should fill in an online immigration form no more than 3 days before you arrive.
entry.es: Debes rellenar un formulario de inmigración en línea no más de 3 días antes de llegar.
entry.quote: Fill in an online immigration form no more than 3 days before you arrive.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: You should make sure the border control officer stamps your passport.
entry.es: Debes asegurarte de que el oficial de control fronterizo selle tu pasaporte.
entry.quote: Make sure the border control officer puts a stamp in your passport.

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: It is illegal to overstay the entry period or to work without a work permit.
entry.es: Es ilegal exceder el periodo de entrada o trabajar sin permiso de trabajo.
entry.quote: It’s illegal to overstay the entry period or to work without a work permit.

safety.en: There is a continuing serious risk of homicides, primarily gang related and involving guns.
safety.es: Existe un riesgo grave y continuo de homicidios, principalmente de bandas y con armas de fuego.
safety.quote: There is a continuing serious risk of homicides, primarily gang related and involving guns.

safety.en: You should avoid isolated areas, including beaches, after dark.
safety.es: Debes evitar las zonas aisladas, incluidas las playas, después del anochecer.
safety.quote: avoid isolated areas, including beaches, after dark

safety.en: Muggings at gunpoint while you are in the water have become increasingly popular, so hide your valuables.
safety.es: Los atracos a punta de pistola mientras estás en el agua son cada vez más frecuentes, así que oculta tus objetos de valor.
safety.quote: Muggings at gunpoint while you are in the water have become increasingly popular criminal activities, so make sure to hide your valuables.

safety.en: Currents can be deceptively strong and not all beaches have lifeguards or warning flags.
safety.es: Las corrientes pueden ser engañosamente fuertes y no todas las playas tienen socorristas o banderas de aviso.
safety.quote: Currents can be deceptively strong and not all beaches have lifeguards or warning flags.

safety.en: The hurricane season in the Caribbean normally runs from June to November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes en el Caribe suele ir de junio a noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season in the Caribbean normally runs from June to November.

safety.en: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.
safety.es: Es ilegal que cualquier persona, incluidos los niños, vista ropa de camuflaje.
safety.quote: It’s illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.

health.en: Medical treatment can be expensive, so you need adequate travel health insurance and funds for treatment and repatriation.
health.es: El tratamiento médico puede ser caro, así que necesitas un seguro médico de viaje adecuado y fondos para tratamiento y repatriación.
health.quote: Medical treatment in St Lucia can be expensive. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment and repatriation.

health.en: The Tapion Hospital does not accept travel or foreign medical insurance for payment.
health.es: El Hospital Tapion no acepta seguros de viaje ni médicos extranjeros como forma de pago.
health.quote: The Tapion Hospital does not accept travel or foreign medical insurance for payment.

health.en: The main government hospital can cope with many types of treatment, but serious cases may mean emergency evacuation.
health.es: El principal hospital público puede atender muchos tipos de tratamiento, pero los casos graves pueden requerir evacuación de emergencia.
health.quote: The main government hospital can cope with many types of treatment, but serious cases may mean emergency evacuation.

health.en: You should carry a copy of the prescription for any medications you bring.
health.es: Debes llevar una copia de la receta de los medicamentos que traigas.
health.quote: Carry a copy of your prescription for any medications you bring with you

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink, though bottled water is widely available.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber, aunque hay agua embotellada por todas partes.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink; however, bottled water is widely available for those who desire it.

help.en: The emergency number in St Lucia is 911 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Santa Lucía es el 911 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Contact your travel provider and insurer if you are involved in a serious incident or emergency abroad.
help.es: Contacta con tu agencia de viajes y tu aseguradora si te ves envuelto en un incidente grave o una emergencia en el extranjero.
help.quote: Contact your travel provider and your insurer if you are involved in a serious incident or emergency abroad.

getting_in.en: George FL Charles Airport (SLU) is near Castries.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto George FL Charles (SLU) está cerca de Castries.
getting_in.quote: George FL Charles Airport (SLU IATA), which is near Castries.

getting_in.en: Hewanorra is the larger airport, and international flights from Europe and continental North America arrive there.
getting_in.es: Hewanorra es el aeropuerto más grande y a él llegan los vuelos internacionales de Europa y Norteamérica continental.
getting_in.quote: Hewanorra is the larger of the two airports in St. Lucia. International flights from Europe and continental North America arrive at this airport.

getting_in.en: A taxi from Hewanorra to the Rodney Bay resort area is expected to cost 80 to 90 USD.
getting_in.es: Se espera que un taxi desde Hewanorra a la zona turística de Rodney Bay cueste de 80 a 90 USD.
getting_in.quote: Expect to pay 80 to 90 USD for a taxi ride to the Rodney Bay resort area in the north of the island.

getting_in.en: Cruise ships are frequent visitors to the harbour in Castries.
getting_in.es: Los cruceros visitan con frecuencia el puerto de Castries.
getting_in.quote: Cruise ships (usually one or two at a time) are frequent visitors to the small, picturesque harbour in Castries.

getting_in.en: Express des Isles runs the most extensive official ferry service, with routes to Martinique, Guadeloupe and others.
getting_in.es: Express des Isles opera el servicio oficial de ferris más amplio, con rutas a Martinica, Guadalupe y otras.
getting_in.quote: The most extensive official service is operated by Express des Isles , which runs services to Martinique, Guadeloupe, etc.

getting_around.en: The main way for tourists to get around Saint Lucia is by taxi.
getting_around.es: La principal forma de moverse para los turistas en Santa Lucía es el taxi.
getting_around.quote: The main way for tourists to get around Saint Lucia is by taxi, either arranged by the hotel, taxi agency or individual operators.

getting_around.en: Taxis are not metered, so you should agree the fare in local currency with the driver before setting off.
getting_around.es: Los taxis no tienen taxímetro, así que debes acordar la tarifa en moneda local con el conductor antes de salir.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are not metered. Standard taxi fares exist for most destinations. Agree the fare in local currency with the driver before you set off.

getting_around.en: Local buses are small vans holding around 10-14 people and vary in quality.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses locales son furgonetas pequeñas para unas 10-14 personas y su calidad varía.
getting_around.quote: local buses provide a cheap and fun way of getting around. They are small vans which hold around 10-14 people and vary in quality.

getting_around.en: Driving is on the left-hand side and drivers require a permit.
getting_around.es: Se conduce por la izquierda y los conductores necesitan un permiso.
getting_around.quote: Driving is on the left-hand side and drivers require a permit

getting_around.en: Water taxis are a quick way to reach private beaches or coastal towns over short distances.
getting_around.es: Los taxis acuáticos son una forma rápida de llegar a playas privadas o pueblos costeros a distancias cortas.
getting_around.quote: Water taxis are a main source of income for many locals and can be a much quicker, convenient and picturesque method of traveling short distances to private beaches or coastal towns.

getting_around.en: Roads can have potholes and speed bumps, and minor and rural roads are often narrow and steep.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras pueden tener baches y badenes, y las secundarias y rurales suelen ser estrechas y empinadas.
getting_around.quote: Roads can have potholes and speed bumps. Minor roads and roads in rural areas are often narrow, with steep gradients, hairpin bends and blind corners.

money.en: The currency is the East Caribbean dollar.
money.es: La moneda es el dólar del Caribe Oriental.
money.quote: The currency of the country is the East Caribbean dollar

money.en: The East Caribbean dollar is pegged to the US dollar at US$1 = EC$2.70.
money.es: El dólar del Caribe Oriental está vinculado al dólar estadounidense a US$1 = EC$2,70.
money.quote: It is pegged to the United States dollar at an exchange rate of US$1 = EC$2.70.

money.en: You can often pay taxis in US dollars as well as East Caribbean dollars.
money.es: A menudo se puede pagar el taxi en dólares estadounidenses además de dólares del Caribe Oriental.
money.quote: You can often pay in US dollars as well as East Caribbean dollars.

money.en: You may need identification as a visitor to qualify for duty-free prices.
money.es: Puede que necesites identificarte como visitante para acceder a precios libres de impuestos.
money.quote: You may need identification as a visitor to qualify for duty-free treatment.

etiquette.en: All beaches in St. Lucia are open to the public.
etiquette.es: Todas las playas de Santa Lucía son públicas.
etiquette.quote: All beaches on St. Lucia are open to the public.

etiquette.en: Nude sunbathing is illegal in St. Lucia.
etiquette.es: Tomar el sol desnudo es ilegal en Santa Lucía.
etiquette.quote: Nude sunbathing is illegal in St. Lucia.

etiquette.en: It is uncommon for couples, opposite or same-sex, to show affection in public in St Lucia.
etiquette.es: Es poco habitual que las parejas, de distinto o del mismo sexo, muestren afecto en público en Santa Lucía.
etiquette.quote: It is uncommon for opposite or same-sex couples to show affection in public in St Lucia.
